description: This file is a React component written in TypeScript for a Next.js project. It manages the user interface for a Career Navigator application, enabling users to upload documents, generate and manage AI-driven personal personas, and navigate through different workflow states (initial, draft, processing, finalized). It includes complex UI interactions, API integrations, state management, and orchestration logic related to persona creation and validation.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value into a string array, filtering out non-string entries.

methods.name: isNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Determines whether a value is a non-null, non-empty object.

methods.name: getInitials
methods.description: Generates initials from a string, used for avatar display.

methods.name: getNestedOrchestrationValue
methods.description: Safely accesses nested properties in an object based on a path array, returning both value and path.

methods.name: logAvailableKeys
methods.description: Logs the keys of an object and its nested artifacts for debugging.

methods.name: extractPersonaJsonFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Extracts persona JSON payload from orchestration response by inspecting various possible paths.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Maps backend persona JSON into the UI's PersonaData format, attempting to normalize differing shape formats.

methods.name: fingerprintPersonaData
methods.description: Creates a fingerprint string for PersonaData instance for change detection.

methods.name: fingerprintPersonaArtifact
methods.description: Creates a fingerprint string for an artifact payload, used for caching and change detection.
